script: Giant and colossal squid have the largest eyes of any animal, up to about 27 centimeters across. Scientists think these huge eyes help them spot sperm whales, their main predator, in the dark. Giant squid can grow to around 12 meters long, including their tentacles. The first video of a live giant squid in the deep sea was filmed in 2012. Many sperm whales carry round scars from the suckers of squid they have hunted.
